title: Registry and archive downloads refuse URLs that are not credential-free HTTPS
summary: `fetchBounded` (`@inventarch/distribution/internal/bounded-fetch`), the one request behind registry documents and remote archives, now checks the URL itself before any request, even when its caller did not: a URL that is not a canonical credential-free HTTPS URL without query or fragment, such as one with credentials, a query, a fragment, another scheme, an uppercase or non-ASCII host, or a space, refuses with `IA-DIST-INPUT-INVALID` and names the URL. Every URL the registry and archive checks admit still passes, a bare trailing `?` or `#` included, so registry, catalog and restore reads behave as before. Redirects, the 30-second timeout and the byte bounds are unchanged.
